reason: I already have my gummies and I reorder them when they run out, so I'm not going to switch for a brand I just saw. The lab report is a nice touch, but I'd want to talk to my doctor about which magnesium before I buy a new one.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone feels like less for $30.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor told me bisglycinate specifically is what I need, or if the price were closer to what I pay now for my usual one.
